title: Systems Architect
description: We are seeking a Systems Architect to design the core infrastructure that powers our data-intensive products at global scale. You will own the high-level technical vision for distributed systems, database topologies, and the security boundaries that protect them. You will lead design reviews, champion scalability trade-offs, and guide teams toward event-driven and cloud-native patterns. This staff-level role is fully remote and expects deep, hands-on systems thinking with clear communication across engineering leadership.
